name: Password Generator
description: Generate secure random passwords with customizable length, character sets, and entropy estimation.
longDescription: Password Generator creates cryptographically secure passwords tailored to your requirements. Adjust length (4-128 chars), include/exclude character types (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols), avoid ambiguous characters. Real-time entropy calculation shows strength. Generate multiple passwords at once. Passphrase mode for memorable but secure passwords. All generation happens client-side.
pricingDetails: Completely free. No limits, no tracking, no account.
